title: tc-email-draft
description: An agent-written email waiting for review: recipient, attachment, tones, inline editing, Discard and Send.

reference.description: Reference of the record, e.g. a subscription or invoice number

account.description: Account or company under the reference

status.description: Status chip next to the reference

contacts.description: The people the email can go to – the recipient list offers them; the first is picked unless `recipient` says otherwise

recipient.description: The email of the contact it goes to – unset is the first contact; one not in `contacts` falls back to the first

attachment.description: The file attached – removing it is remembered for that file only, so a new attachment shows again

tones.description: Text variants to switch between – the first one is shown first

tone.description: The id of the tone shown – unset is the first; one not in `tones` falls back to the first

link.description: Label and target of the link appended to the email

undoSend.description: The receipt offers Undo for a send (tc-undo takes it back) – unset: only when there's no `onSend`

undoDiscard.description: The receipt offers Undo for a discard (tc-undo takes it back) – unset: yes

demo.description: Demo mode: sending without onSend is simulated silently. For galleries and prototypes
